## What changed

Two changes to how an agent writes and finds documentation in your project.

- **Agents are now told to keep documents small and non-overlapping.** A
  document should cover one specialty. If two documents overlap, they either
  belong merged or the shared part belongs in a third one. A fact that another
  document already states should be linked, not repeated — a second copy drifts
  until the two disagree. The rule is added to the conventions block `lat init`
  writes into `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the `lat-md-conventions` skill, so
  it applies on your next `lat init`.

- **This project split its own 36 KB fork document into five.** No effect on
  your project. It is the same rule applied to our own documentation, and it
  is how we found that the mode check is a good test of whether a document is
  really two.

## Upgrading

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
